# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta12

## Prepared live-route backend adoption

This prerelease is the second frontend phase of the Prepared Render Model migration.
It moves the authoritative active route backbone from raw point arrays to the
integration-prepared content-addressed live-route SVG resource while preserving
the existing raw trail path as a complete compatibility fallback.

### Single mower

- Read the latest `live_route` descriptor from the Prepared Render Model manifest.
- Fetch/cache the content-addressed `live_route_render_model` resource.
- Render backend-prepared `segments[].path_d` directly instead of rebuilding the
  complete authoritative route from raw point arrays in the browser.
- Keep only the short MQTT/browser tail that extends beyond the backend
  `point_count`, so the mower marker does not outrun the backend route while the
  integration coalesces live builds.
- Reject another trail session or invalid prepared route and keep the existing raw
  trail renderer visible.
- Reuse live resource bodies across card instances.

### Multi mower

- Load the prepared live-route resource per member using the existing
  integration-owned prepared manifest path.
- Render prepared member-local SVG paths inside the existing Site API member
  transform.
- Preserve a short raw live tail after the backend point count.
- Include prepared live resource identity in Multi render fingerprints so a newly
  published route replaces only the affected map state.
- Keep the existing member raw `trail_segments` renderer as fallback.

### Request behaviour

The integration remains authoritative for route segmentation, gaps, cycle/reset
identity and route publication. The card does not add a second resolver.

Manifest reads are rate-limited in the frontend and the backend already coalesces
active live preparation to at most one build per 2 seconds. Content-addressed
resource bodies are fetched only when their resource id changes.

### Compatibility and safety

- Navimower 0.4.5-beta24 or newer is recommended.
- Older integrations without Prepared Render Model discovery stay on the existing
  raw trail renderer.
- Failed/missing/stale prepared live resources never blank the current trail.
- History/session archives and current-cycle per-zone artifacts are unchanged.

### Regression coverage

Add a beta12 regression covering:

- prepared Single live-route rendering;
- backend matrix transform;
- short raw/MQTT tail preservation;
- stale trail-session rejection;
- content-addressed resource reuse;
- shared live-resource cache across card instances;
- presence of the prepared Multi live-route path.

## Field-test signal

With NaviMower 0.4.5-beta24 while a mower is active, diagnostics should now show:

- `prepared_render_model.manifest_reads` increasing;
- `live_resource_reads > 0`;
- `static_resource_reads` remaining low/stable after initial adoption;
- zero prepared-render failures;
- live publication/build counters advancing during mowing.

The visible route should continue reaching the mower through the short live tail
between backend live-route publications.
